title: Melomakarona: Orange and Spice Cookies Soaked in Honey Syrup
summary: Soft olive oil and orange cookies spiced with cinnamon and cloves, dunked hot into cool honey syrup and topped with walnuts.
equipment: 2 baking trays lined with baking paper

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Make the syrup first
steps.text: Put the sugar, water, orange wedges, cinnamon stick and cloves in the small saucepan, bring to the boil and simmer for 5 min. Take it off the heat, stir in the honey and leave it to cool completely, then lift out the orange and whole spices. The syrup must be cool when the cookies are hot, or they turn soggy.

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.text: Set the oven to 190 °C (170 °C fan) and line the two trays with baking paper.

steps.title: Whisk the wet mix
steps.text: In a large bowl whisk the olive oil, orange juice, grated zest and 35 g sugar for about 1 min until the mixture looks cloudy and slightly thickened.

steps.title: Stir the dry mix
steps.text: In the second bowl stir together the flour, semolina, cinnamon, ground cloves, bicarbonate and salt so the raising agent is evenly spread.

steps.title: Fold gently
steps.text: Tip the dry mix into the wet and fold with the spatula just until a soft, slightly oily dough forms. Stop as soon as there is no dry flour left; working it longer develops the gluten and makes the cookies tough.

steps.title: Shape the ovals
steps.text: Scoop level tablespoons of dough, about 30 g each, and roll them into 5 cm ovals. Set them 3 cm apart on the trays and press the tops lightly with a fork for texture.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake for 22-25 min, swapping the trays halfway, until the bases are deep golden and the cookies feel firm.

steps.title: Dunk in syrup
steps.text: While they are still hot, lower 4 or 5 at a time into the cool syrup for 10-15 s, turning them so they soak evenly, then lift onto the rack with the slotted spoon.

steps.title: Top with walnuts
steps.text: Sprinkle the chopped walnuts over each cookie while the surface is still sticky, then leave for 15 min so the syrup sets.

tips: Hot cookies and cool syrup are the key contrast; a common mistake is dunking cool cookies, which barely absorb anything.
Use a mild, fruity olive oil, or half olive and half sunflower oil for a lighter taste.
Do not overmix the dough: it should look a little greasy and break easily.
Leftover syrup can be spooned over yoghurt.
safety: Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Keep in an airtight tin at room temperature for up to 1 week; they become softer and more honeyed after a day.
